question.text: An infrastructure debt fund scheme must invest what minimum percentage of scheme assets in debt securities or securitized debt instruments of infrastructure companies/capital companies/projects/SPVs, other permitted assets, or bank loans?

explanation.text: The Logic: An infrastructure debt fund scheme must invest a minimum of 90% of its scheme assets in debt securities or securitized debt instruments of infrastructure companies/capital companies/projects/SPVs, other permitted assets, or bank loans. The Trap: 75% is the combined limit for real estate MF schemes, not infrastructure debt funds. Note: Source-backed contrast: 90% (infrastructure debt fund scheme) vs 75% (real estate MF scheme).
